1.w: For the music director, to be accompanied by stringed instruments; a psalm of Asaph, a song. God has revealed himself in Judah; in Israel his reputation is great.

2.w: He lives in Salem; he dwells in Zion.

3.w: There he shattered the arrows, the shield, the sword, and the rest of the weapons of war. (Selah)

4.w: You shine brightly and reveal your majesty, as you descend from the hills where you killed your prey.

5.w: The bravehearted were plundered; they “fell asleep.” All the warriors were helpless.

6.w: At the sound of your battle cry, O God of Jacob, both rider and horse “fell asleep.”

7.w: You are awesome! Yes, you! Who can withstand your intense anger?

8.w: From heaven you announced what their punishment would be. The earth was afraid and silent

9.w: when God arose to execute judgment, and to deliver all the oppressed of the earth. (Selah)

10.w: Certainly your angry judgment upon men will bring you praise; you reveal your anger in full measure.

11.w: Make vows to the Lord your God and repay them. Let all those who surround him bring tribute to the awesome one.

12.w: He humbles princes; the kings of the earth regard him as awesome.
